title: thelypteris angusticaudata
intro: Thelypteris angusticaudata, commonly known as the narrow-footed maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the kingdom Plantae and is native to Central and South America. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris angusticaudata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
